source_locator: PDF p. 31 / printed p. 31, Figura 16, 'Evolución del empleo en el videojuego español (2013-2022)'.
definition: DEV's estimated direct employment in Spanish video-game development. The figure separately labels 2022's freelance and indirect jobs, so this is not a supported-employment total. The report's current-edition methodology describes a DEV studio survey/estimate, but the historical chart does not document each prior-year sampling frame.
